scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/check-type-escapes.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test && node --test test/live/redact.test.ts test/live/gas.test.ts test/live/retry.test.ts test/live/mode.test.ts test/live/rpc-proxy.test.ts test/live/anvil.test.ts test/live/matrix.test.ts test/live/lock.test.ts test/scripts/ci-all-os-decide.test.ts test/scripts/user-pages.test.ts test/scripts/doc-snippets.test.ts test/scripts/check-deprecated-packages.test.ts test/scripts/deprecation-hook.test.ts test/scripts/mermaid-blocks.test.ts test/scripts/node-test.test.ts test/scripts/pack.test.ts test/scripts/hardhat-cli-spawns.test.ts test/scripts/verify-release-tag.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test:unit
scripts.test:localstack: pnpm run build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @hardhat-kms/aws run test:localstack
scripts.test:examples: pnpm run build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @hardhat-kms/aws run test:examples
scripts.test:live:aws: pnpm run build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @hardhat-kms/aws run test:live:aws
scripts.test:live:azure: pnpm run build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @hardhat-kms/azure run test:live:azure
scripts.test:live:gcp: pnpm run build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @hardhat-kms/gcp run test:live:gcp
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run coverage
scripts.pkg:check: pnpm run build && node scripts/check-packages.ts && node scripts/check-deprecated-packages.ts && knip
scripts.release: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && changeset publish
